example.bn: ওয়েল্ডিং শপে মেশিনের জায়গা আলাদা, আর CBLM রাখার জায়গা তার পাশেই।
example.en: A welding shop has a practical work area with machines. Learning materials sit in a nearby resource area.

short.modelAnswer:
When preparing a CBT shop layout, consider:
1. Areas allow smooth work flow of trainees and trainers.
2. Support materials and learning aids are readily available and accessible.
3. Security, safety and well being of the trainee come first.
4. Materials, supplies, tools and equipment are stored safely and securely.
5. Ventilation and illumination of each area.
6. Caution signs are placed.

realQuestions.label: CBLM 10 Self Check 1 (Q1)
realQuestions.question: List the facilities you need to ensure in your CBT shop.

realQuestions.answer:
When preparing a CBT Shop Layout, the following factors should be considered;
• Areas are designed to facilitate smooth work flow of trainees and trainers.
• The support materials and other aids for learning are readily available and
accessible.
• Security, safety and well being of the trainee are prioritized.
• Security and safety in the storage of materials, supplies, tools and equipment.
• Ventilation and illumination of each area should be considered.
• Caution signs are placed.
